class.name: GridLayoutManager
class.brief_description: Lays items out in a fixed number of columns (or rows).
class.description:
GridLayoutManager arranges items into a grid with [method set_span_count] columns (rows for a horizontal layout). Items are placed left to right until the accumulated span fills a line, then a new line starts. Row height is the tallest item in the row. Items may span multiple columns via a [b]SpanSizeLookup[/b].
[b]Example[/b]: [codeblock] var layout := GridLayoutManager.new() layout.set_span_count(3) recycler_view.set_layout(layout) [/codeblock] Use [method set_span_size_lookup] to let some items span multiple columns.

method.name: get_item_column
method.description: Returns the column the item at [code]position[/code] is placed in (0 when out of range).

method.name: get_item_row
method.description: Returns the row the item at [code]position[/code] is placed in (0 when out of range).

method.name: get_row_count
method.description: Returns the total number of rows.

method.name: get_row_height
method.description: Returns the height of the given row (0 when out of range).

method.name: get_row_offset
method.description: Returns the starting offset of the given row (0 when out of range).

method.name: get_span_size_lookup
method.description: Returns the current span size lookup.

method.name: set_span_count
method.description: Sets the number of columns (rows for horizontal), minimum 1. Marks the row model dirty.

method.name: set_span_size_lookup
method.description: Sets the [b]SpanSizeLookup[/b] that reports how many columns each item spans. The row model is rebuilt.
